task.description:
Produce a design artefact at src/design/dsl-09-date-builtins.md covering:

1. Function signatures for now(), date_add(ts, n, unit), date_diff(ts1, ts2, unit)
2. Unit support: second, minute, hour, day вЂ” with millisecond multiplier definitions
3. UTC-only constraint: all time math uses UTC milliseconds since Unix epoch, no timezone conversion
4. Null propagation rules: any null argument в†’ null return
5. Type coercions: timestamp or int64 accepted as timestamp inputs; int64 for n; string for unit
6. Error cases: unknown unit, wrong argument count, overflow handling
7. Cross-DST boundary semantics: day = 86400000ms irrespective of DST transitions (pure UTC arithmetic)
8. now() impurity note: now() is the only impure built-in; date_add and date_diff are pure given explicit timestamps

The code already exists in src/expr/mod.zig (lines 335-354 for now(), 511-549 for date_add, 553-588 for date_diff, 605-612 for dateUnitMultiplier). This design doc formalizes the interface.

Acceptance criteria:
- Document covers all 8 points above
- Cross-DST boundary arithmetic is explicitly specified as pure ms arithmetic

result.summary: Design artefact for DSL-09 date built-ins: now(), date_add(), date_diff()
